title: Research sprint goal: Landing and close: clause credit by carrier, ledger checks by item, the code-lane wait and checks that run behaviour
goal: The sprint goal's open questions are answered with the kb tools first and the live docs for the gaps, and the findings are written as kb facts and gap entries through the kb skills, so each committed item can name the knowledge it needs. Tested rows for kb/_self/_retrieval/lookup_eval.csv are a code-lane path (_tools/kblane.py): a story finished with them lands through backlog.py land ID --wait-merge SECONDS, not done --commit.
notes: Planned 2026-10-13: the goal's questions (how close --summary credits a clause to a carrier, which ledger rows done attributes to an item, whether land waits for a code-lane merge request, when the review confirms a provisional answer) concern this repository's own tools and its _self docs, which the sprint's items edit. rag.py pack --root _self answers them from backlog.md and tools.md (the review question good, the other three weak on wording only) and root public holds no page on them, so no live-docs fact is to be researched: its done needs the line "No outside facts: <reason>" in these notes, written by the worker that runs it, and its goal stays unnarrowed since no question is weak or none against a source outside the repository.
